item.description:
### Added - **Muse: approve, reply and stop from Perch.** With Muse set to "Ask me", its approval requests now come to your phone, watch and Mac, and you can answer them there. You can also reply to a Muse session or stop it from your phone or a Mac notification. Perch won't type into Muse while it's showing you a question or an approval, or while it has put a stopped prompt back in its input box. - **Muse in Stats.** Turns, tokens, model and active time for Muse sessions now appear in Stats. - Muse sessions show Muse's own icon on the Mac. - Groundwork for the next iPhone update.
### Changed - **Muse approvals with no phone nearby go back to the terminal after 10 seconds** instead of 45, because Muse's screen stays blank while Perch holds the request.
